boringtun implements the standard WireGuard protocol, where a handshake initiation message is fixed at 148 bytes on the wire (4 type + 4 sender index + 32 ephemeral + 48 encrypted static + 28 encrypted timestamp + 16 MAC1 + 16 MAC2), which is what boringtun's handshake-init size constant encodes. Note I can't verify the exact identifier offline — the name I firmly recall in boringtun is `INITIATION_MESSAGE_SIZE`, also 148.

ANSWER: 148
